stem: Which virus is the most common cause of bronchiolitis in children?
explanation: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) is the most common cause of bronchiolitis in children.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because rhinovirus commonly causes upper respiratory tract infections and can contribute to wheeze, but it is not the leading cause of bronchiolitis.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) is the most common viral cause of bronchiolitis in children.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because parainfluenza virus is more commonly associated with croup than bronchiolitis.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because adenovirus can cause respiratory infection, but it is not the most frequent cause of bronchiolitis.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because influenza virus can cause lower respiratory tract disease, but it is not the usual cause of bronchiolitis.

source.hint: Look for the virus often abbreviated as a three-letter acronym.
